metadata.title: Chatbase HelpDesk - AI Customer Support with Human Handoff Walkthrough
metadata.description:
Chatbase HelpDesk manages support tickets, lets your team reply to customers live, handles handoffs from your AI agent, and keeps every conversation in one inbox.

In this demo we'll walk you through how your customer support agent hands those conversations off to your team with full context, and hands them right back when you're done. No separate tool, no manual tracking.

00:00 - HelpDesk Introduction
00:24 - AI-to-human handoff with full context
00:56 - Comprehensive ticket management
01:40 - Handing back to AI: return any ticket or live chat to the AI agent
02:03 - Omnichannel support across email, chat, WhatsApp, and Instagram
02:29 - Detailed analytics for improved support efficiency

🔗 See Chatbase Helpdesk: https://www.chatbase.co/features/helpdesk
🔗 Try Chatbase free: https://www.chatbase.co/

#Helpdesk #AIHelpdesk #AICustomerSupport #SupportTickets #ChatbaseAI #HumanHandoff

metadata.title: Chatbase for Shopify - Install an AI Agent in Under 5 Minutes
metadata.description:
Chatbase for Shopify is a native conversational AI agent that searches your live product catalog, recommends products, looks up orders, and adds items to the cart, all inside the chat, without a customer leaving the conversation.

In this walkthrough I install the Chatbase Shopify app on a store from scratch and turn on the actions that power it, product search, order lookup, and cart management, in under five minutes. No embed code, no developer knowledge.

00:00 - The agent in action
00:58 - Installing the Shopify app 
01:22 - Turn on actions in the editor
01:34 - Configure Order lookup 
01:55 - Live on the store in under 5 min

🔗 Full setup guide: https://www.chatbase.co/docs/user-guides/integrations/shopify
🔗 Try Chatbase free: https://www.chatbase.co/


#Shopify #ShopifyApps #EcommerceAI #AISalesAgent #ChatbaseAI #Ecommerce #aicustomerservice
